_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - this is a shape reference, not content. Which species a run meets, at what depth,
is DELIBERATELY NOT DECIDED (plan 2.14 fixed the mechanism and left the contents open).
It is DISABLED by "weight": 0 on every entry - the generator drops entries at or below zero, the
same way the biome rotation does. A pool that shipped enabled would decide the wild half of every
run on every server that installed the mod, which is exactly what the mod does not get to decide.
EVERY file under wild_pools/ is loaded and the UNION is the pool, so an addon datapack can add
species without editing or shadowing yours. Weights are relative across the whole union.
Without at least one enabled entry somewhere, WILD WAVES REFUSE TO START and the run stops at its
first non-trainer wave. That is the failure this file exists to make obvious.
Any field whose name starts with '_' is ignored. Every other unknown field is an error, so a typo
is reported instead of silently taking a default.
_entries: species  - any registered species id, from any mod. Not checked here: this file is read during the
same reload that builds the species registry, so an unknown id is reported when the
weight   - relative likelihood among everything eligible for that wave. <= 0 disables the entry.
min_wave/max_wave - the depth band this species belongs to. Both optional. The level curve scales
whatever is drawn, so a window is about what BELONGS at a depth, not how strong it is.
properties - extra Cobblemon PokemonProperties tokens, appended after the species and level the
generator writes. Shinies, forms and aspects go here; passed through unparsed.
